data.title: Nadifloxacin 1% cream
data.category: More from Khopkar · Topical antibacterials & antiseptics
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Topical antibacterials & antiseptics_

**Class:** Topical fluoroquinolone

## Mechanism of action
- Inhibits DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV → bactericidal against C. acnes, S. aureus (including MRSA) and S. epidermidis; also anti-inflammatory (reduces cytokines)

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Inflammatory acne (with BPO), impetigo, folliculitis, infected dermatoses

## Dose & formulations
- Twice daily; acne up to 8–12 weeks with BPO

## Adverse effects
- Itching, irritation, contact dermatitis (rare)

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity to quinolones

## Pregnancy & lactation
Avoid (limited data).

## Viva points
- Topical quinolone for acne in India/Japan; combine with BPO to prevent resistance

_Sources: Khopkar ch.18; Wolverton 4e ch.41. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
